need.question: Once lit, how fast does the flame spread and how large does it get?
need.reading: A counted test records the material, the flow speed and direction and a spread rate, burn length or burn time. In the current tables the counted tests record a burn time and no spread rate or burn length; a burn time is not a spread rate.

sentences.text: How NASA documents treat this question, as quoted items of the reference list: 10 criteria, requirements or definitions and 8 questions or research needs.

Of the 10 criteria, 0 state an oxygen and a pressure inside the ranges of this environment, 0 state at least one of its conditions and none outside, and 10 state no oxygen, pressure or gravity level that can be compared.
The questions and research needs are quoted from documents of their own dates; the list does not say what NASA considers open today.
The six needs are the team's construction, and which items are listed for a need is an AI reading of the items that was not checked by a person.

sentences.text: None of the 2 tests counted for this need was recorded with oxygen and pressure both inside the ranges of this environment, and none was recorded inside one of the two ranges with the other value not in the table.

The 2 counted tests by match with this environment: 0 with oxygen and pressure both inside the ranges; 0 with oxygen inside the range and no pressure in the table; 0 with pressure inside the range and no oxygen in the table; 2 with none of these matches.

The experimental table of PSI-98 holds no pressure. A NASA record or a paper of the investigators says: "All tests were performed at normal pressure (1 atm) and the pressure increase due to combustion was insignificant." (source: SAF17.pressure). The sentence is not used as a value of any test.

cells.recorded: Counted tests of this need in this cell: 0 with oxygen and pressure both inside the bins, 2 with oxygen inside the bin and no pressure in the table, 0 with pressure inside the bin and no oxygen in the table. 0 of these 2 are also matched to the environment itself.

sentences.text: This environment covers 1 cell of the coverage grid (oxygen bin by pressure bin). Of the 4 cells one step away in oxygen or in pressure, 1 holds a counted test of this need matched by oxygen, by pressure or by both.
A test at a neighbouring condition is not evidence for this condition.

A test with oxygen in the table and no pressure is counted in every pressure bin of its oxygen bin, and a test with pressure and no oxygen in every oxygen bin of its pressure bin. The same test is therefore in more than one cell, and in a cell that shares a bin with this environment it can be a test already listed at the condition; each cell gives that number. Counts of cells are not to be added.

not_covered.why: Named as a gap by the prevention group of NASA/CP-2003-212103 (CP2003.prev.smolder) and in the organizing questions of 2004 (CP2004.flam.q7); no need of this file is about it, and no standard variable marks a test as non-flaming or smoldering.

not_covered.area: Background particulate and chemical species in the cabin
not_covered.why: First organizing question for fire signatures and detection (CP2004.det.q1); no need of this file is about it. The DAFT record (PSI-47) is in the catalogue: its objective field says 'The focus of DAFT / DAFT-2 was to mitigate the risk for the Smoke Aerosol Measurement Experiment (SAME).', and its table is one row per sampling session, which the pipeline does not map.

not_covered.area: From small-scale experiments to large-scale fires
not_covered.why: Organizing question 5 of 2004 (CP2004.flam.q5); the pipeline does not relate tests of different sample size to each other.

not_covered.area: Detector location and time to detection
not_covered.why: Named as knowledge that detection depends on (TB008.location); no standard variable holds a detector position or a time to detection.

not_covered.area: Flame spread over thermally thick versus thin materials
not_covered.why: Named by the prevention group (CP2003.prev.thickthin); the pipeline carries a sample thickness where the table gives one and does not class a test as thermally thick or thin.

not_covered.area: Flammability limit of liquid fuels as a prevention question
not_covered.why: The limiting oxygen index is named a principal objective of FLEX and tied to spacecraft fire safety (TP216046.loi; see also RG.droplet, FLEX.objective1). The team's scope 'solid' keeps the FLEX tests out of P1; they are counted for S1 only.

not_covered.area: Fire prevention as the stated focus of BRE (PSI-20)
not_covered.why: NASA documents name BRE as the ACME experiment focused on spacecraft fire prevention (ACME14.bre, RG.bre, ACME21.bre). This file links PSI-20 to S1 only, with verdict 'differs', and its table is one row per test day, so no test is counted.

not_covered.area: Ignition delay of the BASS-II PMMA rods
not_covered.why: Defined and reported by the investigators in the BASS-II Summary Report (BASS2TM.igndelay); the PSI-25 experimental table has no column for it, so need P2 has no counted test.

steps_informed.label_by_team: System or configuration evaluation when a material that fails Test 1 is proposed
Measures named for that case: replace with nonflammable material, restrict propagation paths, eliminate or control ignition sources, materials usage agreement

process.team_reading: Team's reading (AI, not checked by a person): tests that record flame spread over a solid material relate to the configuration evaluation and to the measures that name propagation paths.

measures.quote: The primary methods used by NASA to reduce flammability hazards are the limitation of flammable materials by replacement with nonflammable materials and the restriction of propagation paths
